learnings.rule: Downscale large user-uploaded images on the client (e.g. createImageBitmap + canvas, ~1600 px long side, WebP/JPEG ~0.8) before encoding or uploading; leave PDFs unchanged.
Handle explicit server CONFLICT errors with a localized message and refresh stale view state instead of showing a generic failure toast.
Avoid filler taglines, helper text and redundant secondary labels; let layout and clear control labels carry the screen.
Guard async effects against stale responses on unmount/param changes and keep interactive controls keyboard-accessible with explicit accessible names.
